COMPLETE ORIGINAL USER REQUEST:
생활사 박물관의 소규모 전시 포스터 3종을 만들어 주세요. 모두 세로 2:3입니다. 흑백만 쓰되 사진과 그래픽은 사용할 수 있습니다. 오래 쓰며 손에 익은 열쇠와 손잡이를 주제로 한 전시입니다. 열쇠의 마모와 손잡이의 닿는 부분이 주제에 연결되게 해 주세요. 이 물건의 실제 관계가 충분한 크기의 비문자 시각 중심이어야 하고, 글자와 여백이나 작은 기호만으로 끝내지 마세요. 으스스한 범죄물이나 골동품 상점 광고처럼 보이지 않았으면 합니다. 아래 문구를 모두 그대로 넣고, 없는 유물 번호나 연대는 만들지 마세요.

DESIGN SPEC FOR EXACTLY ONE POSTER, R7-B07-M1:
Produce one single flat opaque finished portrait poster, width:height 2:3. No mockup, border around a photographed poster, multiple panels, contact sheet or extra image. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.
Use case: photorealistic-natural, a small everyday-life museum exhibition poster. Only black, white and neutral grayscale. No tint or sepia. The visual is an invented ordinary household door for composition, no claim of a specific artifact or model.
A continuous close three-quarter photographic view of ONE ordinary light-gray painted door fills the whole canvas. This real door surface also serves as the left text space; do not place an independent white editorial card or a footer strip. Gentle daylight from upper left, moderate soft contrast, natural short shadows, no ominous dark hallway, crime atmosphere or antique-shop styling.
On the right half, show a substantial everyday metal lever handle mounted to a round rosette/rotation spindle, below it a cylinder lock on this SAME door with an everyday metal key fully inserted. Both must be structurally readable, grounded on the door, complete from mounting plate to lever tip and from cylinder keyhole to the short exposed neck and rounded key bow. The blade and teeth are inside the cylinder; never show a dangling exposed blade disconnected from the lock. The key bow projects out and hangs slightly downward in a physically plausible inserted position. No human hand, no loose floating keys, no extra lock or handle.
Make the handle an unmistakably large visual focus occupying the upper-middle right, roughly between 30–47% of canvas height; the inserted key occupies the middle-right at about 55–66% height. The handle's grip is large enough that a localized smooth brighter rubbed patch along its upper/front gripping surface is legible. Contrast this softly polished contact patch with less worn satin metal nearer the spindle. The key bow has softened bright worn outer edges where fingers grasp it, with less-worn shallow metal in the center. Fine natural localized wear, not uniform corrosion, repeated decorative scratches or distressed texture. Preserve continuous metal curvature, coherent reflection direction, natural focus and clean physical edges without halos. Both objects connect clearly to the same door and show the sequence of unlocking then opening without explanatory labels.
Text is crisp black flat Korean typography on the left door plane, with normal Hangul syllable proportions, visible counters, balanced strokes and natural word spaces. Do not squeeze type horizontally. Reserve ample left-column width first for the hours and unbroken URL. Keep all typography away from objects and their shadows.
At the handle grip height, set the exact title in two semantic lines: 손이 기억하는 / 물건, where the slash describes a line break and is NOT printed. This title has strong weight and stable word spacing, approximately 7% canvas-width letter height, and stays in the left half. Immediately below is the complete subtitle, allowed to wrap only at a word boundary if needed.
The visit information flows down the left in three readable groups alongside the inserted key, rather than in a small strip at the bottom. Date and venue form the first group. Hours and free admission form the next group. Guidance and URL form the final group. Use an approximately 2.1% canvas-width minimum letter height for essential smaller information, sufficient black/gray-plane contrast and airy line spacing. If the long hours need wrapping, break after the slash or before 월요일; retain the slash, both en dashes, all digits and spaces. The final entry can break after 전시 안내, but example.org/hand-memory MUST stay unbroken on one line. Do not change the specified punctuation or word boundaries. The left information column extends approximately to 76% canvas height with generous bottom space as part of the same photographed door.
The title's horizontal level echoes the lever and the downward information path echoes the inserted key's lower location. The handle and key remain sufficiently large that covering the text still leaves a substantive, content-grounded image of unlocking and opening with repeated finger contact wear.
Print only the seven supplied copy strings, once each. No role IDs, dates besides the exact date copy, headings from these instructions, labels, decorative pseudo-text, logo, sponsor, watermark, invented artifact number or historical claim. All seven copy entries are mandatory; no abbreviation or extra words.

argument_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON sorted keys without extra whitespace
maintained_features: One continuous ordinary-door photograph; same-door lever and inserted key; local contact wear; adjacent left information column
scope_note: The planning-only no-generation sentence is superseded by the current explicit native production instruction. Before native invocation, a metadata-only assertion selected the wrong pin index; the immutable call-input was retained and the helper pin was correctly checked by its explicit path.
